Section 1.
That Section 10.12.130, City traffic engineer, of Chapter 10.12,
Administration and Enforcement, of Title10, Vehicles and Traffic, is hereby amended assetout in
this ordinance. Sections currently existing in Chapter 10.12 not set out within this ordinance remain

10.12.130
City traffic engineer.
The office of the city traffic engineer is established. The city traffic engineer must
be a qualified enginer, who will be appointed by the mayor with the consent of city council. The
traffic engineer will exercise the powers as provided in this title and in the traffic ordinances of the
city.
It is the general duty of the city traffic engineer, under the supervision and
direction of the city engineer, to determine the installation and proper timing and maintenance of
traffic-control devices, to conduct engineering analyses of traffic accidents and to devise remedial
measures, toconduce engineering investigations of traffic conditions, toplan the operationof traffic
on the streets and highways ofthe city, and to cooperate with other city officials in the development
of ways andmeans toimprove traffic conditions, and to carry out the additional powers and duties
imposed by city ordinance.
Section 2.
This ordinance shall be in full force and effect upon its approval and
publication.
